_readme: S739 lever, East Los Angeles College. Paid read 45769480150 (only=38332,45540) handed each program its sister award's section: the Geo-Spatial Engineering and Technologies certificate 38332 was read from PDF pp.198-199, which print the Associate in Science (Academic Plan E038337C) alone, and the Respiratory Therapy B.S. 45540 from pp.343-345, the Associate in Science (E002458C), so each record places none of its listed courses. This read prints each program's own plan line, '(Academic Plan E0<control number>...)', and the pages that name the certificate and the bachelor's upper-division courses, with the two pages after each, so a session can name a pdf_pages pin for each own section or name its gap. One PDF load and robots.txt, no model call, nothing written.

questions.own_page: Where each program's own section opens (its heading or plan line and the first line of its requirement list) and where its list ends (its total), so a pdf_pages pin can name the page, the words it opens on and the page it runs through.
